label: Dubstep / Briddim (Riddim Drums, Brostep Sound Design)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 140-150 BPM, felt half-time 70-75 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: A cinematic, tense intro with a ticking pulse builds with snare rolls and a fake-out silence, then the first drop loops a lurching, talking bass motif. A second motif answers it in call-and-response, a breakdown strips to a pad and a sub…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Short, clipped vocal one-shots, such as hype shouts and single words, are cut into the build-ups as rhythmic punctuation.
cards.palette: A vowel-like, formant-swept mid-bass voice plays a syncopated two-bar motif over a clean sub, answered by a metallic, saturated second voice in the other half of the loop.
cards.tempo_line: written 145 BPM, felt half-time as 72 BPM

cards.mood: Opens with a brooding drone and filtered bass previews, tightens with a riser and a short silence, and lands a heavy, hypnotic first drop. The riff changes timbre every four bars, a short breakdown gives air, and the final drop stacks a…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: A resampled FM and wavetable mid-bass plays a bouncing off-beat motif with comb and formant filtering and heavy saturation, over a mono sine sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 150 BPM, felt half-time as 75 BPM

cards.mood: A tense, spoken-style call opens the track over a bare beat, a build with rising pitch leads to a bouncing drop, and the chant returns between the phrases while the bass trades motifs. A final drop adds a harder second voice.
cards.vocal: A small group of voices chants in unison with a gruff, shouted timbre; there is no lead singer.
cards.palette: A rubbery, wet mid-bass loop with square-wave modulation and a harder, distorted answer voice trade phrases over a clean sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM
